# Two-voice Study

Original PLAY CLI fixture, dedicated to CC0-1.0. The SVG sources and MusicXML
are redistributable test assets; production Sound Pack audio remains external.

Two printed pages contain measures 1–2 and 3–4 respectively. Each measure is
4/4 at quarter=100: upper staff C4, F-sharp5, C4, F-sharp5 quarter notes;
lower staff A-flat3 whole note. F-sharp carries to the second F in each bar;
A-flat is restated each measure. Each voice lasts 16 quarters (9.6 seconds).

Visual cross-check on 2026-09-12: both SVG pages were rendered with the local
Quick Look viewer and inspected. The treble bottom ledger line is C4, the
space above the top line is F5 with a sharp, and the bass top line is A3 with
a flat. All 20 events were checked against the four displayed measures.
This is an Agent-authored fixture cross-check, not an independent OMR benchmark.
It does not establish accuracy on the user's Canon PDF or human listening approval.
